project_title: Provenance-Aware RAG for Evidence-Supported Encrypted Traffic Classification

USTC-TFC2016.label_source: top-level release category only: Benign or Malware
USTC-TFC2016.split_rule: group-disjoint by source capture/class file; no row-random split

CIC-Darknet2020.processing: published flow/CSV data -> schema/label audit -> feature contract
CIC-Darknet2020.split_rule: group-disjoint when an authoritative group key exists; otherwise deterministic stratified split frozen after audit

hard_rules: Never derive a label from filename/path unless that mapping is explicitly part of the authoritative release contract.
Never fit imputation/scaling/feature-selection on validation or test.
Never use row IDs, raw IP addresses, MAC addresses, absolute timestamps, or source filenames as predictors.
Disable NFStream L7 dissection for the USTC primary baseline to avoid DPI/application shortcut leakage.
Persist row-level probabilities, predictions, metrics, curves, calibration bins and hashes for later figures.
Every stage uses inspect -> implement -> validate -> analyze -> continue.
Existing outputs are immutable; new runs use unique run IDs.
